The '''2022 Supercopa de España''' was the 38th edition of the [[Supercopa de España]], an annual [[Association football|football]] competition for clubs in the [[Spanish football league system]] that were successful in its major competitions in the preceding season.

After the previous season's edition was held in [[Andalusia]], Spain due to travel restrictions related to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], this year the tournament returned to [[Saudi Arabia]] as per the deal with the [[Royal Spanish Football Federation]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Kohan |first1=Marisa |title=Así es Arabia Saudí, el país que albergará la Supercopa y que viola derechos humanos |url=https://www.publico.es/sociedad/supercopa-futbol-arabia-saudi-pais-albergara-supercopa-viola-derechos-humanos.html |access-date=14 June 2020 |work=www.publico.es |date=15 November 2019 |language=es}}</ref>

[[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] won the tournament for their twelfth Supercopa de España title.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/60018825 |title=Athletic Bilbao 0-2 Real Madrid: Luka Modric scores in Super Cup final win|date=16 January 2022 |work=BBC Sport|access-date=16 January 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/2022/01/16/61e481b0ca4741226d8b458c.html|title=Modric and Benzema fire Real Madrid to the Supercopa title |newspaper=Marca |first=Euan |last=Mctear |date=16 January 2022|access-date=16 January 2022}}</ref>

==Qualification==
The tournament featured the winners and runners-up of the [[2020–21 Copa del Rey]] and [[2020–21 La Liga]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rfef.es/sites/default/files/pdf/betting_in_english_0.pdf|title=Supercopa de España|website=www.rfef.es|access-date=13 January 2022}}</ref>

==Venue==
All three matches were held at the [[King Fahd International Stadium]] in [[Riyadh]], [[Saudi Arabia]].<ref>[https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/2160444/the-2022-spanish-super-cup-has-a-clasico/amp The 2022 Spanish Super Cup has a Clásico], FC Barcelona, 25 May 2021. Retrieved 23 October 2021</ref><ref>[https://www.athletic-club.eus/en/news/2021/06/28/athletic-will-play-in-the-super-cup-from-january-12-16 Athletic will play in the Super Cup from January 12-16], Athletic Bilbao, 26 June 2021. Retrieved 23 October 2021</ref><ref>[https://www.goal.com/en/amp/news/when-is-the-next-el-clasico-the-dates-of-real-madrid-vs/2uq1e7998cfo1g1c1nwcyvell When is the next El Clasico?
